skills.officialDescription: Constrict time at the present junction, and invoke a Veil of Compressed Time to protect you for 10 seconds, decreasing the damage and DoT damage you take by 40%, and increasing your Haste by 15%. In the presence of a Temporal Rift, the Daybreak Radiance heals you, applying a 10 second HoT based on its stacks.
